topic: MemCompiler ScienceWorld compiler artifact and remaining evaluated-memory-state gap

observations.claim: The public Hugging Face profile xinrui-23 currently lists a ScienceWorld-specific Qwen2.5-14B MemCompiler model artifact and a Qwen3.5-27B ScienceWorld model, in addition to AlfWorld/Habitat artifacts.

The Qwen2.5-14B ScienceWorld artifact is xinrui-23/sciworld-5.0-16-Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Its current tree is 34.8 GB with two commits; immutable commit 3c0bae02a6411205b97738e8ef59fd61c4905339 adds pytorch_model.bin with LFS oid sha256:f7cd6ce554b4f9cb8cfc62f56da7f8e594a851123955f513518c3ab654ba17e5 and size 34,819,915,776 bytes.
observations.exact_scope: Artifact identity and weight-object digest only; no model card or run manifest binds this checkpoint to a particular published evaluation row.

observations.claim: MemCompiler Table 3 evaluates the Qwen-2.5-14B executor on ScienceWorld and reports Full 46.67/69.33 versus AMMI 27.93/52.68 while explicitly holding the retrieved memory M the same.
observations.exact_scope: Paper-level matched delivery ablation. The public paper does not expose the bytes/digest of the evaluated ScienceWorld memory database or candidate pool in Table 3.

observations.claim: The same Hugging Face profile currently lists only two public datasets, alfworld_dataset and alfworld_dataset_new; no ScienceWorld dataset/memory-bank repository is listed on that public profile.
observations.exact_scope: Absence is limited to the observed public profile listing; alternate public URLs, hidden/unlisted repositories, later releases, and private artifacts are not excluded.

protocol_implication: EVALUATED_MEMORY_STATE_BUNDLE can now bind a ScienceWorld-specific compiler checkpoint to an immutable Hugging Face revision and model-weight LFS SHA256, but Table 3 replay still lacks a public binding for the evaluated ScienceWorld memory database/candidate-pool bytes and run manifest. A model checkpoint alone remains insufficient.
next_probe: Search public project/account surfaces for a ScienceWorld memory-database/candidate-pool artifact or run manifest keyed to the above checkpoint; if absent, require explicit memory DB/candidate-pool digests in replay sidecars.
